subject: POC kickoff recap - scope, metrics, owners, next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: POC kickoff recap - scope, metrics, owners, next steps

Hi John / Sarah,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we're aligned before the formal kickoff: 

Key pain points you emphasized:
- High latency on customer-facing chat (95th percentile spikes during peak) leading to abandoned sessions.
- Rising token costs on current vendor with limited batching and caching.
- Need for predictable inference SLA for enterprise customers (auditability + access logs).

Goals for the POC (success criteria):
1) Reduce 95th percentile latency for chat from ~1.2s -> <=550ms for 99% of requests (measured at our edge).
2) Improve cost per 1k responses by >=25% via batching + KV caching without degrading response quality.
3) Demonstrate traceable request logs and token-level cost breakdown for audit.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): Access & infra setup (API keys, service account, minimal network config).
- Week 1: Baseline run (2K daily chat requests) using your current prompts; collect latency/cost baseline.
- Week 2: Optimizations (batching, prefix/KV cache, quantization knob if acceptable).
- Week 3: End-to-end evaluation: latency, cost, and prompt-quality regressions against your eval set.

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (Engg + GTM), Aditya Rao (Solutions / Onboarding), Rishi Malhotra (Inference lead).
- Acme: John Doe (Product lead), Sarah Lee (SRE / infra).

Access / setup items we need from Acme:
- A short-lived service account with read-only access to the test dataset (S3 link) OR a sample export of 1K chat rows (CSV).
- Temp environment or staging endpoint where we can route test traffic (DNS or load balancer info).
- Contact for procurement to pick a POC billing owner (we'll send pricing options).

Metrics we will report weekly:
- 50/95/99 latency percentiles, p99 tail, average tokens per response, cost per 1k responses, regression delta on your prompt eval set (precision/recall or composite score).

Attachments: attached a draft POC scope and SOW for review (acme_poc_scope_v1.pdf, pilot_sow_draft.docx).

Suggested next steps:
- Confirm that we can get the service account / sample data this week.
- Can we schedule a kickoff meeting to go over onboarding and firewall/NAT rules? I have Wed 4/7 or Thu 4/8 open.

Happy to adjust - thanks again.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference - production-first LLM inference
From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap - scope, metrics, owners, next steps

Thanks Marissa - this looks good and captures the conversation. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency target: the product team is comfortable with <=600ms p99 for the POC (we'll confirm with execs but 550ms is fine as aspirational).
2) Data access: we can produce a sanitized sample of 1,500 chat rows (will drop PII) and upload to the S3 test bucket by EOD Tuesday.
3) Security/compliance: can you send a short list of what logs and retention policies you collect for the POC? Our security team will want to review before we give access.

Kickoff meeting: Thu 4/8 at 10:00am PT works best for our infra team - Sarah will lead the session.

I'll loop in procurement offline for the POC billing owner; expect them to reply separately.

John
Product Director, Acme Corporation
john.doe@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap - scope, metrics, owners, next steps

Perfect - thanks John. Two quick items: 

1) Security notes (short):
- For the POC we will only collect request/response metadata and token-usage logs tied to an opaque request id. We retain logs for 30 days by default for debugging - we can adjust retention per Acme policy for the POC.
- No production keys or customer PII should be included in the sample; our onboarding checklist flags PII.
- We'll share our SOC 2 summary and a list of required firewall rules prior to the kickoff.

2) Timing: Thu 4/8 10:00am PT confirmed for kickoff - I've added a calendar invite and included Sarah. Agenda: access & networking, data handoff, baseline run plan, measurement dashboards.

I've attached the same scope & SOW docs for reference. If the security team needs anything specific before kickoff, please point them to me or Aditya.

Thanks - excited to get started.

Marissa

Attachments: acme_poc_scope_v1.pdf, pilot_sow_draft.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 13:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap - scope, metrics, owners, next steps

Adding a few technical onboarding notes so Acme knows what to expect at kickoff: 

- Preferred test traffic pattern: 2k requests/day, 95% short chat turns (avg 120 tokens), 5% long conversation threads. Please include a sample CSV with columns: request_id, prompt, context_history (optional), expected_response.
- Auth: we'll provide a scoped API key for the POC with usage caps; recommend creating a short-lived service account or OAuth client so we can rotate credentials post-POC.
- Network: outbound TLS to our hosted endpoints. If you're routing through a private VPC connector, we'll need the egress IPs (I'll share a small CIDR list).
- Eval: please include a 50-case prompt evaluation set (gold responses) so we can run quality regressions after optimizations.

I'll be on the kickoff to lead the optimization work.

Rishi
Lead, Inference Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
